versions.changelog: Add post-nudge hold packet so operators wait after one reminder instead of treating continued silence as a final itinerary.
Add copy-ready no-reply nudge packet so operators can remind a silent traveler without treating silence as a go-ahead for a final itinerary.
Add copy-ready unclear-reply packet so operators can retry when a traveler answer is vague without sending a fake final itinerary.
Add copy-ready two-turn send script stitching outbound message, expected reply, and follow-up while keeping the still-do-not final-itinerary guard.
Add copy-ready follow-up send packet after traveler reply so acknowledgement is not treated as a final itinerary.
Add reply_intake_card: accepted traveler replies, if-answered next move, and still-do-not guard after outbound send packet.
Add output_polish.outbound_send_packet with a copy-ready traveler message, send/hold status, and a do-not-add guard so clarifying questions are not sent as fake final itineraries.
Add send/hold decision card so operators get one safest reply form, primary blocker, and copy-ready instruction before over-sending a provisional plan.
Add operator review queue for prioritized clarification, fallback, live-check, constraint, and continuity tasks before sending or expanding a plan.
Add operator-visible decision risk meter for output polish send-readiness
Add operator_review_queue output polish with prioritized owner/severity review tasks before presentation or itinerary expansion.
Add transition validation card with per-hop live-routing pass criteria and fallback reorder/swap actions.
Add operator-visible constraint compliance card for budget, pace, neighborhood, hours, food, and weather preservation checks.
Add operator preflight card for send-readiness and safe live-viability claims
Add operator_next_message output polish scaffold with verified caveat and next-owner preservation.
Add operator-visible evidence trace card for output polish recommendations.
Add operator-visible reply readiness score for output polish
Add output_polish.user_response_choices with copy-ready traveler response examples for clarification, fallback confirmation, and itinerary expansion.
Add verified final reply preview scaffold preserving rationale, evidence, caveats, and next-owner action.
Add output finalization gate with explicit user/operator blocking checks before provisional plans are presented as final.
Add copy-ready live validation prompt pack for operator and traveler checks.
Add operator output digest with decision, rationale, evidence, watch-out, and owner-tagged next action.
Add output_polish decision_snapshot_table for compact operator/UI review.
Add output polish assumption ledger for provisional inputs, offline-data caveats, route scaffolds, fallback warnings, and active constraints.
Add output_polish.validation_summary with operator go/no-go checks, pass criteria, and fallback actions.
Add candidate recommendation explanations with concrete factor evidence
Add output_polish.reply_options with safe user/operator next-action choices.
Add verified quick reply card output polish for concise user-facing next-step recommendations.
Add output_polish.handoff_brief with decision, rationale bullets, watch-out, next action owner, and evidence drivers.
Add output polish status line and confidence drivers for operator readiness summaries.
Add compact presentation_markdown output polish for recommendation, rationale, watch-outs, and next step.
Add verified output polish decision confidence signal with evidence and missing-evidence readiness checks.

Add output polish decision summary and owner-tagged next action checklist.
Privacy refactor: remove organization/personal identifiers and direct hosted CTA URLs; use approved public URL placeholders.
Add output polish response template for consistent operator rendering
Add verified output polish scaffold with compact sections, decision rationale, and next-step actions.

Major refactor: add local-first Notion/Obsidian travel journal mode with route-spine chapters, portable map style tokens, journal schema, validation, and Markdown export scripts. Defers map rendering, EXIF extraction, image AI, Notion API publishing, and Obsidian automation to future tools.
Safety metadata alignment: clarified offline-only runtime, no OAuth/credentials/purchases; marked booking roadmap as non-operational reference; tightened README/SKILL security disclosures.
Harden trust review to block scanner-noise reviewer artifacts before publish.
Add reviewer fingerprint checks (line counts + SHA256) and explicit offline helper scope to improve trust review clarity.
Trust hardening: extended static checks to cover gen-airports network imports and updated verifier docs.
Exclude .openclaw loop artifacts from published package to reduce false socket anomaly signals.
Hardened stale precheck-marker detection in socket-review checks for safer trust scans.
Harden socket anomaly guard by scanning hidden files for stale ralph-precheck markers and ambiguous socket-pass flags.
Broadened static guardrails for ambiguous Socket-pass markers and stale precheck artifact references to reduce marketplace false-positive trust ambiguity.
Harden socket/network trust checks by extending local static guards for socket-capable binaries and Python network clients, while excluding non-network urllib.parse usage.
Tighten trust review guardrails for Socket anomaly markers and allowlist persistent loop state file.
Tighten transient precheck artifact guard (.json) and package hygiene checks.
Expand static trust review to scan helper generator scripts for offline/non-dynamic behavior.
